pricing_page_title: Subscribe or buy credit packs — whatever fits how you work
pricing_page_subtitle: Subscriptions suit steady use; credit packs suit occasional use or a temporary top-up. You can hold both at the same time and they add up.
pricing_page_subscriptions_desc: Subscription credits are granted monthly and valid for the current period
pricing_page_packs_desc: One-time purchase, never expires, not affected by monthly/yearly billing
pricing_page_pack_order: When you also hold a subscription, credits are used by expiry: subscription credits first, packs last.
pricing_page_payments_unavailable: Payments are currently unavailable. You can still explore the plans.
pricing_page_error_desc: Pricing is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
pricing_page_empty_desc: Sign up now to get free credits.
pricing_page_faq_1_q: What is the difference between subscription credits and credit packs?
pricing_page_faq_1_a: Subscription credits are granted once per billing period, and unused credits do not roll over when the period ends. Credit packs are a one-time purchase and stay valid long term.
pricing_page_faq_2_q: Which credits are used first when I hold both?
pricing_page_faq_2_a: Credits that expire first are used first: daily credits claimed today, then current subscription credits, and long-term credit packs last.
pricing_page_faq_3_q: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
pricing_page_faq_3_a: Yes. After cancelling, your benefits last until the end of the current period, and purchased credit packs are not affected.
pricing_page_faq_4_a: Credits belong to the workspace, so members of the same workspace share one balance.
pricing_page_packs_desc_expiry: One-time purchase, not affected by monthly/yearly billing
